description: WHEN TO CALL: when you need a capability and don't know which tool provides it, and want several options rather than route_task's single pick. Takes a plain-language query ('send a slack message', 'convert currency') and returns live tools ranked by fit, each with its input schema, connection endpoint and free/paid status, so you can call one immediately.

category.description: Optional capability category to narrow results.

query.description: Plain-language description of the capability you need (e.g. 'send an email').

name: discover_tools
